releases.name: v1.2.0 — reveal in tree, position memory, collapsible tree
releases.body:
Reveal a file in the tree, remember where you were, and get the tree out of the way.

- **Reveal in the file tree** — right click an open tab (or press `F10` with the
  editor focused) and pick *Reveal in the file tree*. Expand mode expands the
  folders and selects the file; navigate mode enters its folder. Dotfiles get
  un-hidden and a hidden tree comes back.
- **Position memory** — scroll and cursor line/column survive `F4` toggles and
  tab switches. The preview status shows `Ln X/Y`.
- **Collapsible tree** — `F6` or the `«` in the explorer header hides the tree,
  leaving a narrow `»` strip to click it back. Shortcuts stay in the footer.
- **Wrap and gutters** — wrapping hides the line numbers in the preview too, and
  turning it off restores them. Horizontal scrollbar in the viewer and editor.

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser@latest
```

Tests: 32 + 32 end-to-end assertions in a real TUI, 8 navigation unit tests.

releases.name: v1.1.0 — context menus, copy/move and horizontal scrolling
releases.body:
Context menus, file copy/move and horizontal scrolling.

- **Right click the empty area** of the explorer: new file, new folder and paste.
- **Copy / Move to…** from a file or folder menu. Move opens a folder picker
  with a `.. (up)` row, navigable by keyboard and mouse.
- **Navigate mode**: clicking a folder now opens it (before it toggled a tree
  state that does not exist in that mode) and the chevron no longer lies.
- **Footer shortcuts are always visible**; transient messages moved to their own
  line and clear after six seconds.
- **Preferences**: two-line rows and a wider dialog, so descriptions are no
  longer truncated with `…`.
- **Wrap** hides the line numbers in the viewer too, and a **horizontal
  scrollbar** appears when wrapping is off (viewer native, editor click-to-jump).

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser@latest
```

Tests: 32 + 22 end-to-end assertions in a real TUI.

releases.name: v1.0.3 — no dead ends in navigate mode
releases.body:
Fixes the dead end in **navigate** mode (Folders → navigate):

- `Shift+Enter` (collapse) now returns to the project root instead of clearing
  an invisible tree state and appearing to do nothing.
- Navigate listings start with a clickable `↰ ..` row; the path in the header
  also goes up on click.
- A folder that fails to load keeps the previous listing instead of an empty
  screen, and an empty folder explains how to leave.
- Navigation rules moved to `src/lib/navigation.ts` with 8 unit tests that run
  in CI before publishing, plus an end-to-end navigate scenario.

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser@latest
```

releases.name: v1.0.2 — install without the dev toolchain
releases.body:
Install fix.

The first public build shipped its build toolchain in `devDependencies`. OpenCode
installs plugins with `npm install --include=dev`, so a cold install downloaded
TypeScript, Babel and the whole OpenTUI tree and the prepare step stalled past
the TUI startup budget.

- `prepack` removes `devDependencies` from the packed manifest, `postpack`
  restores the working copy; the repo keeps the full toolchain.
- The published tarball has no `devDependencies` (20 files, ~66 kB).

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser@latest
```

releases.name: v1.0.0 — explorer, editor and git in the TUI
releases.body:
Explorer, editor and git panel for the OpenCode TUI, in one plugin.

## Highlights

- **Explorer** — expand folders in place or navigate into them, name/content
  search (case-sensitive option), hidden files, branch and change count.
- **Editor** — tabs, line numbers, syntax colours while editing, `Enter` for a
  new line, `Ctrl+F` inside the file, `Ctrl+S`, scrollbar and click-to-place
  cursor.
- **Changes** — stage, unstage, discard, commit, pull, push, branches and
  history; `Enter` opens a unified diff, `F4` jumps to the file.
- **Preferences** — `F2` modal with simple mode, line numbers, wrap, folder
  behaviour, panel preview, changes panel, hidden files, mouse, search target
  and confirmations.
- **Context menu** — right click or `F10`: new file/folder, rename, delete,
  close this/other/all tabs.
- **Safe with huge files** — 2 000 rendered lines; above 20 000 lines or 2 MiB
  a metadata placeholder keeps the TUI responsive.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser@latest
```

Restart OpenCode (or `/reload`).

## Tests

Two end-to-end suites drive a real TUI in tmux against a git fixture:
`test/e2e.sh` (32 assertions) and `test/e2e-extra.sh` (11 assertions), both
green on OpenCode 2.2.5.

Project page: https://arthurrogado.github.io/opencode-file-browser/
